articles.summary: Fahd Aijaz Joins From ING as a Managing Director Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, today announced the appointment of Fahd Aijaz as a Managing Director in the Oil Gas Group. Based in London, Mr. Aijaz will lead the firm’s industry coverage of European companies and investors, in collaboration with other senior partners across the global Oil Gas Group. Mr. Aijaz brings a wealth of expertise in advising leading corporates and private capital investors, having advised on more than 50 transactions across the traditional energy, oil and gas (both EP and infrastructure), utilities, and energy expansion sectors, including leading IPOs, MA transactions, and debt financings during his 19-year career. He joins after seven years with ING, where he was a Managing Director and Head of the Energy Commodities team. articles.title: Houlihan Lokey Further Expands Global Oil & Gas Group With Senior Hire in London

articles.summary: Adnan Choudhury Joins as a Managing Director in the Business Services Group Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Adnan Choudhury has joined the firm as a Managing Director in its Business Services Group. Based in London, Mr. Choudhury will focus his coverage on professional services across Europe, further strengthening the group’s sector expertise and client reach across the region. Mr. Choudhury brings more than 13 years of investment banking experience, joining from Perella Weinberg Partners, where he was part of the U.K. Advisory team, leading coverage of the services sector. He has built deep expertise advising corporate and financial sponsor clients on a broad range of complex MA, leveraged finance, and equity capital markets transactions across the business, industrial, and professional services landscape. articles.title: Houlihan Lokey Expands European Business Services Capabilities With Senior Hire

articles.summary: Greg Han Joins as Managing Director in New York Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Greg Han has joined as a Managing Director in its Power, Utilities, and Renewables Group. Based in New York, Mr. Han will focus on advising corporate and financial sponsor clients across the power and utilities sectors, including conventional power generation and renewable energy. Mr. Han brings more than 20 years of investment banking experience to the firm. Most recently, he served as a Managing Director at Rothschild Co., where he led the firm’s North American power, utilities, and renewables advisory practice, growing its presence in one of the firm’s core global infrastructure verticals. articles.title: Houlihan Lokey Expands Power, Utilities, and Renewables Group With Experienced Hire

articles.summary: Kyle MacRae Joins as a Managing Director in New York Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Kyle MacRae has joined the firm’s Capital Solutions Group as a Managing Director. Based in New York, Mr. MacRae will focus on GP-led secondaries advisory for the firm. Mr. MacRae joins the firm from Baird, where he was most recently a senior member of its GP Solutions Group, focusing on continuation vehicles and other GP-led transactions. Prior experience includes time in the GP-led secondaries advisory unit of the Private Funds Group at Credit Suisse. “Kyle’s background in GP-led secondaries and his insight into the sector will enhance our ability to deliver exceptional outcomes to our clients,” said Gregg Newman, Global Co-Head of Capital Solutions at Houlihan Lokey. “We continue to attract premier talent to the platform as we seek to respond to client needs and build a market-leading secondaries practice. We are thrilled to welcome him to the firm.”
articles.title: Houlihan Lokey Further Strengthens Equity Capital Solutions Capabilities With Senior Hire

articles.summary: Chen Na Joins the Firm’s Equity Capital Solutions Practice as a Managing Director in New York Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Chen Na has joined the firm’s Capital Solutions Group as a Managing Director. Ms. Na is based in New York and will serve as a senior financial professional on the Equity Capital Solutions team, focused on leading direct equity transactions. Ms. Na joins following a 15-year career at Stifel, where she was most recently a Managing Director and Head of Technology MA. While at Stifel, Ms. Na was instrumental in building out that firm’s U.S. Technology MA practice, originating and executing MA transactions across a number of technology verticals, including tech-enabled services, software, and hardware and electronics. articles.summary: Transaction Further Strengthens Existing Coverage Capabilities in Beauty, Personal Care, and Pet Health Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, has agreed to acquire Vicente Partners, a premier independent advisory firm with deep expertise in the beauty, personal care, and pet health sectors across Europe and the United States. The transaction was signed on 30 October 2026. Vicente Partners was established in London in 2020 by Alejandro Vicente, the former Global Head of Consumer Goods Investment Banking at J.P. Morgan. Mr. Vicente has more than 30 years of fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) experience, including 17 years at J.P. Morgan and eight years in senior roles at large corporates. He will join Houlihan Lokey as a Managing Director, alongside fellow Partners Lidiia Gaiduk and Michelle Garcia. articles.summary: · Across the full market, defaults rose to 1.5% of outstanding loan principal from 0.8% the quarter before, with healthcare and consumer sectors seeing the most stress. Companies with less than $100 million of EBITDA saw defaults rise to 3.9% compared with 3.0% in the second quarter. · Borrowers with EBITDA below $20 million experience a wider range of outcomes and greater earnings volatility, leading to underperformance compared with larger issuers. Loans in this cohort valued below 90% of par have risen from roughly 1% in 2023 to 11% today. · Borrowers with $20 million to $100 million of EBITDA continue to show signs of increasing stress; borrowers above $100 million remain the least impacted.
